Time is not good...
Aug 2025 • Family
I was at this place back in 2018. Decided to visit this institution again in Nha Trang. But alas... There's no trace of the old charm. First, the sign. Part of the sign is no longer on fire. Second, a sense of desolation and abandonment. Tablecloths are old with stains (that's still fine), but napkins with mold and crumbs on the tables are just disgusting. The second table to the right of the stairs was adored by ants. Thirdly, whereas in the past the restaurant owner used to approach and interact with the customers and check out the dishes himself, nowadays he no longer... He was sitting with a suspended view at his desk in his laptop... Specifically about the kitchen itself. There was a meat set for two people and a beer. The beer's great, but the questions about the web are that the microwave didn't subside for a second while cooking. The patties weren't ready. The schnitzel was dry and clearly warming up... As for the price - not cheap, as last time - but in 18 it was objectively worth it, now absolutely not. I wanted to show my wife a good German restaurant, but I ended up upset myself.

What A Meal
Jan 2025 • Couples
OMG I want to die here, if you love meat this is the restaurant for you it's typically German tasting and is everything I wanted. We had the mix platter for 2 that included the pork knuckle, chicken schnitzel, meatballs, sausages and sides of potatoes, sauerkraut and salad, with mustard and gravy to dip into. It was totally delicious and the platter cost approx £20. We also had a stein of draught beer and a bottle of wine and spent a lovely evening working our way through the platter. The restaurant is closing in August 25 so please go before it closes you won't be disappointed.

Glorious meat feast!!
Feb 2024 • Family
On our last day in Nha Trang after swimming in some crazy waves, my family and I worked up a tremendous appetite for lunch before we headed to the airport. I looked on Trip Advisor and came across Bremen and we were not disappointed. We ordered chicken schnitzel, pork knuckle, BBQ ribs and the meat sharing platter for two. The food was delicious, tender meats that were cooked to perfection combined with huge portion sizes. This was a delightful find and I would highly recommend this to anybody who loves their meat. 
An added bonus was I could use some USD that we won in the casino too.
